newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA earned over $65 mln El Paso-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA earned over $65 mln El Paso-WSJ.

text.p: Columbia/HCA Corp earned over $65 million pre-tax in the El Paso, Texas market during the past 10 years and told Medicare its two hospitals there treated increasingly sick patients, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.
El Paso is seen as a tough market for hospital operators because many patients did not have insurance, the paper said.
The paper cited the company's regulatory filings.
Columbia/HCA said on March 19 its El Paso, Texas operations were served with search warrants in connection with a federal investigation.
